name: Ferry Terminal Booking
role: You are a ferry ticket clerk.
speaker: Clerk

tasks.goal: Greet the clerk and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the clerk and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about passenger and car vehicle ferry sailing schedules
tasks.hint: Ask ticket clerk when ferries depart for island.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ferry sailing schedules for vehicles.

tasks.goal: Ask about price difference between standard deck and cabin tickets
tasks.hint: Inquire about seating class options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about deck vs cabin ticket pricing.

tasks.goal: Request vehicle spot reservation for standard passenger sedan car
tasks.hint: Specify vehicle size when booking car deck.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested car deck spot reservation.
tasks.scene_hint: Harbor waves lap against wooden pier posts as ship horn sounds in fog.

tasks.goal: Ask about luggage weight limits and check-in procedures
tasks.hint: Inquire how many bags passengers can bring on board.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ferry luggage rules and check-in.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'passageway'
tasks.hint: A passageway is a corridor or walkway allowing access between areas. Ask where the main passenger boarding passageway is located.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'passageway'.

tasks.goal: Inquire if onboard cafeteria serves hot meals and beverages
tasks.hint: Ask about food services during sea crossing.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard ferry food services.

tasks.goal: Negotiate booking refund flexibility in case sea conditions delay sailing
tasks.hint: Ask about weather cancellation policies.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ferry refund policy during sea delays.

tasks.goal: Ask if pets are permitted in designated vehicle decks or cabins
tasks.hint: Inquire about pet travel rules aboard ferry.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pet policy aboard the ferry.

tasks.goal: Address issue where car deck height restriction affects roof rack storage
tasks.hint: Confirm roof rack clearance height with clerk.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved car deck vehicle height clearance restriction.
tasks.scene_hint: Salty ocean breeze fills terminal waiting lounge overlooking loading ramp.

tasks.goal: Ask how early cars must line up in vehicle boarding lanes
tasks.hint: Inquire about vehicle check-in deadline times.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vehicle boarding arrival deadline.

tasks.goal: Confirm total fare charge for vehicle and passenger passengers
tasks.hint: Verify total ticket cost before payment.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed total ferry fare for vehicle and passengers.

tasks.goal: Request printed vehicle boarding pass and cabin ticket receipt
tasks.hint: Ask for paper boarding documents.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed ferry boarding pass and receipt.

tasks.goal: Verify vehicle lane number before driving down loading ramp
tasks.hint: Ask clerk which lane to park vehicle in while waiting.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified assigned vehicle boarding lane number.

tasks.goal: Thank the clerk and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the clerk AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about vehicle height and length restrictions for car deck ferry loading
tasks.hint: Ask ticket agent about vehicle dimension limits on car ferry.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vehicle height and length loading limits.
tasks.scene_hint: A foghorn sounds over the harbor as seagulls cry above the water.

tasks.goal: Ask about passenger lounge amenities and priority boarding options
tasks.hint: Inquire if premium ticket includes priority boarding lounge access.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about priority boarding and lounge amenities.
tasks.scene_hint: The salty ocean breeze drifts through the terminal doors as a large ferry docks.

tasks.goal: Inquire if luggage check-in desk accepts oversized sporting gear like kayaks
tasks.hint: Ask agent about checking large sports equipment.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about checking oversized sports gear.
tasks.scene_hint: Salt breeze carries distant sound of foghorn across bustling waterfront terminal.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'vessel'
tasks.hint: A vessel is a ship or large boat travelling on water. Inquire about high-speed passenger vessel departure times.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'vessel'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'cabin'
tasks.hint: A cabin is a private room on a ship or boat. Inquire about upgrading to an oceanview sleeping cabin.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'cabin'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'docking'
tasks.hint: Docking is the bringing of a ship into a dock or harbor berth. Inquire about harbor docking facilities and turnaround times.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'docking'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'allocation'
tasks.hint: An allocation is the distribution or assignment of designated space. Ask about passenger seating allocation for overnight travel.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'allocation'.

tasks.goal: Ask about life jacket locations and emergency safety briefing procedures on vessel
tasks.hint: Inquire about passenger safety protocols onboard.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard safety and life jacket locations.
tasks.scene_hint: A framed vessel safety diagram showing life jacket storage hangs near the boarding gate.

tasks.goal: Inquire if open-air upper deck features wind protection seating areas
tasks.hint: Ask agent about outdoor seating options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about open-air deck seating amenities.
tasks.scene_hint: Observation deck photos displaying passenger seating hang above the ticket counter.

tasks.goal: Ask whether passenger ticket includes complimentary hot beverage or snack token
tasks.hint: Inquire if basic fare covers onboard drinks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about complimentary beverage inclusions.

tasks.goal: Point out rough sea conditions advisory warning posted on terminal information board
tasks.hint: Inform agent of posted wave height warning.
tasks.done_when: Learner noted rough sea conditions warning board.
tasks.scene_hint: Monitors display amber advisory for moderate swell heights in open bay channel.

tasks.goal: Inquire about pet carrier requirements for traveling on passenger deck
tasks.hint: Ask if dogs must remain inside travel crates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pet carrier guidelines on ferry.

tasks.goal: Ask if ferry cafeteria serves warm meals during 3-hour crossing duration
tasks.hint: Inquire about dining options on long ferry runs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard cafeteria meal service.

tasks.goal: Request explanation of weather cancellation policy and automatic rebooking guarantees
tasks.hint: Ask agent what happens if trip is cancelled due to storm.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested weather cancellation rebooking policy details.

tasks.goal: Inquire about electrical power outlets and Wi-Fi access in passenger seating lounges
tasks.hint: Ask if laptop charging is available onboard.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about power outlets and Wi-Fi access.

tasks.goal: Express concern over motion sickness and inquire about sea sickness medication at gift shop
tasks.hint: Mention concern about seasickness during rough crossing.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed concern about motion sickness.
tasks.scene_hint: Ferry sways gently against dock pillars as tide moves in.

tasks.goal: Ask if vehicle roof racks with bicycles incur additional length surcharge
tasks.hint: Inquire about car roof accessory fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vehicle roof rack surcharge fees.

tasks.goal: Inquire about passenger elevator accessibility between vehicle deck and upper lounge
tasks.hint: Ask if elevator connects lower car deck to main deck.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about elevator access from car deck.

tasks.goal: Ask if overnight ferry offers private sleeper cabin accommodations with shower
tasks.hint: Inquire about cabin amenities on night crossings.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about private sleeper cabin accommodations with shower.

tasks.goal: Point out long vehicle queue line extending outside terminal gates
tasks.hint: Inform agent of heavy car traffic waiting to enter.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported long vehicle line at terminal gate.
tasks.scene_hint: Line of cars honks softly as traffic attendant directs vehicles into lane 4.

tasks.goal: Ask about bicycle storage racks secured on main deck during transit
tasks.hint: Inquire where foot passengers store bicycles.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bicycle storage on main deck.

tasks.goal: Inquire about group discount rates for school field trips or tour groups
tasks.hint: Ask agent if group bookings lower per-person fare.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about group booking ferry rates.

tasks.goal: Negotiate cabin upgrade discount if private cabins remain unsold before departure
tasks.hint: Ask agent for last-minute private cabin discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated last-minute cabin upgrade discount.

tasks.goal: Request clarification on vehicle check-in cutoff times prior to vessel departure
tasks.hint: Ask how many minutes before launch car must be lined up.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vehicle check-in deadline.

tasks.goal: Inquire about designated quiet relaxation zones free from loud announcements
tasks.hint: Ask if ferry has quiet passenger lounge.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about quiet lounge areas on vessel.

tasks.goal: Ask if ferry terminal provides secure multi-day parking garages for foot passengers
tasks.hint: Inquire about overnight terminal parking rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about terminal parking garage facilities.

tasks.goal: Clarify whether round-trip return ticket dates can be left open-ended
tasks.hint: Ask agent if return passage requires fixed time reservation.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified open-ended return ticket rules.
tasks.scene_hint: Agent holds ticket folder explaining open-jaw return validation procedures.

tasks.goal: Ask if passenger vessel features duty-free retail shopping for cosmetics and alcohol
tasks.hint: Inquire about duty-free shop hours onboard.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard duty-free shop options.

tasks.goal: Inquire about vessel sea stability stabilizer fins that reduce rolling motion
tasks.hint: Ask if ferry equipped with anti-roll stabilizers.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vessel anti-roll stabilizer technology.

tasks.goal: Ask if foot passengers are permitted to carry heavy camping backpacks on board
tasks.hint: Inquire about carry-on luggage size limits.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about foot passenger backpack limits.

tasks.goal: Inquire if ferry terminal provides currency exchange desk services
tasks.hint: Ask if foreign currency exchange is open at port.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about port currency exchange services.

tasks.goal: Ask if vessel main deck features observation windows with unobstructed ocean views
tasks.hint: Inquire about panorama window seating.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about observation deck window seating.

tasks.goal: Request agent to reassign seats to window side for panoramic harbor views
tasks.hint: Ask agent to change seat assignment to window.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested window seat reassignment.
tasks.scene_hint: Agent clicks mouse modifying seat grid on computer terminal screen.

tasks.goal: Inquire if commercial freight trucks load on separate lower deck from private cars
tasks.hint: Ask about freight vehicle loading procedures.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about commercial truck loading decks.

tasks.goal: Ask if ferry schedule operates on reduced frequency during winter season
tasks.hint: Inquire about seasonal timetable changes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about winter ferry schedule changes.

tasks.goal: Ask if children under five travel free of charge on all passenger lines
tasks.hint: Inquire about child fare age thresholds.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about free child travel age limits.

tasks.goal: Negotiate waived vehicle length surcharge for compact car with bike rack
tasks.hint: Ask agent to waive extra vehicle length fee.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated waived vehicle length surcharge.

tasks.goal: Ask about harbor shuttle boat services connecting ferry terminal to downtown pier
tasks.hint: Inquire about local water taxi transfers.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about harbor shuttle water taxi links.

tasks.goal: Inquire about electrical vehicle EV charging station availability on car deck
tasks.hint: Ask if electric cars can charge during ferry voyage.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about EV charging stations on ferry deck.

tasks.goal: Ask if ferry ticket includes free transfer to local island bus transit system
tasks.hint: Inquire about onward island bus transit passes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about island bus transfer inclusions.

tasks.goal: Request clarification on port security luggage screening and ID check procedures
tasks.hint: Ask what identification documents are required at boarding.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about port security screening protocols.

tasks.goal: Ask if vessel features outdoor sun deck with lounge chairs for warm weather
tasks.hint: Inquire about outdoor lounge facilities.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about top deck sun lounge amenities.

tasks.goal: Inquire about vehicle tie-down strap safety measures during rough sea crossings
tasks.hint: Ask how cars are secured in heavy waves.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about car deck vehicle tie-down procedures.

tasks.goal: Ask if ferry service offers frequent traveler commuter multi-ride pass booklets
tasks.hint: Inquire about multi-ride commuter ticket books.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about commuter multi-ride ticket books.

tasks.goal: Inquire if passenger deck features nursery baby changing facilities
tasks.hint: Ask about family amenities and nursery rooms.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about onboard baby changing facilities.

tasks.goal: Ask if vessel captain provides navigation commentary on historical landmarks
tasks.hint: Inquire about scenic sight-seeing announcements.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about captain route commentary.

tasks.goal: Inquire about printed boarding pass pickup kiosks at terminal entrance
tasks.hint: Ask agent where self-service boarding kiosks stand.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about boarding pass kiosk locations.

tasks.goal: Confirm final booking payment cost breakdown including port taxes and surcharges
tasks.hint: Verify total ticket price including fuel surcharge.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed total ferry ticket payment cost.

tasks.goal: Negotiate waived reservation change fee when altering return departure time slot
tasks.hint: Ask agent to waive date change fee.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated waived ticket modification fee.

tasks.goal: Ask for printed vehicle boarding permit hangtag to display on rearview mirror
tasks.hint: Request vehicle windshield permit card.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested vehicle mirror boarding hangtag.
tasks.scene_hint: Agent passes heavy cardboard vehicle hangtag over counter window.

tasks.goal: Request formal itemized transaction receipt for tax reimbursement filing
tasks.hint: Ask agent for complete business tax invoice receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested itemized ferry receipt.

tasks.goal: Confirm scheduled ship departure time and assigned vehicle loading lane number
tasks.hint: Verify final departure time and lane assignment.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed departure time and vehicle lane number.

tasks.goal: Ask if ferry terminal waiting room features children play area facilities
tasks.hint: Inquire about terminal family play amenities.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about terminal children play facilities.

tasks.goal: Inquire about passenger luggage trolley availability on ferry loading dock
tasks.hint: Ask if luggage carts are available for foot passengers.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about luggage trolley availability at terminal.
